Human Architecture & Implementation Decision: Implement minimal pure helper resolveAmmoDepletionSnapshot and type CombatCoordinationSnapshot.
No factory function createCombatCoordinationSnapshot is added.
No stateful coordinator or session is introduced.

Guarantee boundary: The helper constructs and returns a complete immutable next coordination snapshot. It does not mutate or replace caller-owned state; actual reference replacement remains the responsibility of a future caller or state owner.

Stale-response boundary: The synchronous API eliminates the delayed precomputed-response window between Domain resolution and snapshot construction. The API does not establish freshness of the input snapshot relative to an external state owner.
EventBatch and EffectIntent are not used.
Historical T-000 through T-025 records and events are preserved without modification.
